protocol: Paper round on B21e (stated waste factors + sheet-goods convention honesty, takeoff detail text only) per review/BLUEPRINTS.md. Four sets: demo-house-FL fc866f2f271b snapshot over HTTP w/ injected bonesframing node at LOD 400 (2194 members, 16 sheets, 128 takeoff rows) AND at LOD 200 (1372 members, 15 sheets — the gross-fallback compose), a hip-roof exhibit (10x8 @ 30 deg, tapered planes -> the under-tile caveat row on paper), and a 9-deck-panel subfloor exhibit (the pre-B21e 'gross' mislabel exhibited live on the BASE sheet). All 47 pin sheets + 47 base sheets rasterized with Playwright page.setContent @2x; every affected takeoff page WALKED. Regression: per-sheet byte-compare pin vs base across all four sets. verdict: APPROVE — the estimate now states its ordering conventions without ever touching member truth, and the proof is cell-level: on every compose the ONLY cells that change vs master are detail-text cells (demo-400 FL: 25, demo-200: 24, pilot's stated baseline-TX compose: EXACTLY the claimed 13 — quantity/unit/section/item columns byte-identical everywhere, both CSVs parse clean at 5 fields/row). On paper the '+X% waste ~ buy' tails print WHOLE via the looping wrapRow (zero ellipsis in any takeoff SVG), legible at the 9.5px row size, the buy figure landing at the end of the row where an estimator reads it, and every printed buy re-derives from the printed net (2x4 84->89, 2x6 61->65, footings 11.9->12.5 yd3, drywall ~78->86 sheets, roof deck ~40->44 — ten rows re-checked by hand). Counted hardware, fixtures, SKUs (line-sets, connectors, register boots), CMU/mortar/grout and bd-ft rows all stay factor-free as enumerated. The hip exhibit shows the roof-deck row carrying BOTH the generic +10% and the 'shortfall NOT covered by the stated waste' under-tile caveat in one readable 4-line wrap, with the underlayment row directly below still saying '+10% course laps' and never 'waste' — the lap-vs-waste distinction is visible on one page. The subfloor exhibit kills the mislabel ON PAPER: base prints '9 sheets (4x8 sheets, gross)' over net holes-carved deck arithmetic, pin prints 'from deck members, net — +10% waste ~ 10 sheets'. Grep across all 47 pin sheets: ZERO 'gross', zero conventions block — the pilot's 'rows verbatim, no block' claim is exact (the convention header is module-doc only). All 39 non-takeoff sheet pairs byte-EQUAL vs master across the four sets. Two FLAG-class items ride the board, not the merge: the pre-existing C5-class paper-vs-panel divergence at LOD-200 (plan-set.ts:2251 calls computeTakeoff WITHOUT areas, so the gross fallback rows — demo-200's 86-sheet drywall buy — print in panel+CSV but never on paper; byte-identical to master, but B21e's checklist sentence 'gross prints ONLY on the LOD-200 fallback rows' is true of the data surfaces and vacuous on paper), and the ceil-bite cosmetics on 1-pc rows ('1 pcs ... +5% waste ~ 2 pcs' reads as +100%).

SWEEP-invariants.evidence: No regressed row. S4 (the row that grew the B21e convention): booked == built proven off the quantity column — cell-diff shows zero quantity changes on three composes; the net-preservation + both-direction enumeration gates run in the suite (takeoff.test.ts B21e describe, 7 gates). P1/P2/A3: geometry sheets untouched — all non-takeoff sheets byte-EQUAL vs master (demo-400 12/16, demo-200 12/15, hip 7/8, subfloor 7/8; the remainder are exactly the takeoff pages). P3/C6: title blocks verified on the rasters (FL + Florida Building Code 8th Ed. + date + LOD 400/200 stamp + SHEET n/N + disclaimer); sheet counts unchanged pin vs base per set. P4: zero ellipsis glyphs across all pin takeoff SVGs; flag block + BUILDING CHARACTERISTICS print byte-identically (the demo-400 4/4 page's 17 red flags all whole). C5: row census identical (129/129 CSV lines demo-400; 101/101 demo-200). Members/fixtures untouched: 2194 members both sides on the demo compose; suite (incl. the E5 master-baseline pin and the B10/S16 manifest gates) green at the pin.
SWEEP-invariants.note: takeoff.ts is the only engine file in the diff; foundation/roof/multistorey test edits are detail-prefix matcher updates only (read in full).

FOCUS-1-waste-rows-on-paper.evidence: Demo-400 sheets 1-2 of 4 walked at 2x: every lumber pcs row prints '<net> pcs (<stock> — +5% waste ~ <buy> pcs)' wrapped whole at word boundaries (the worst case, '2x4 — 8 pcs (20 ft stock (field splice — run exceeds 20 ft) — +5% waste ~ 9 pcs)', takes 3 lines, nothing clipped); the drywall member row prints net sqft + '(~78 4x8 sheets) — +10% waste ~ 86 sheets'; all three concrete pours print '<net> yd3 (<pour> — +5% waste ~ <buy> yd3)'. Arithmetic spot-audit on the printed figures: 84->89, 25->27, 61->65, 4->5, lintels 2.5->2.6, footings 11.9->12.5, stemwalls 1->1.1, slab 8.7->9.2, drywall 2485.7 sqft -> 86 sheets, roof deck 1259.8 sqft -> 44 sheets — every buy = ceil/round1 of the printed net times the stated factor, and buy > net always (ceil(n*1.05) >= n+1). bd-ft rows, CMU 1015 pcs, mortar 51 bags, grout 5.2 yd3, rebar ('laps not included'), and ALL electrical/plumbing/HVAC counted rows factor-free — pages 3-4 walked, no waste text anywhere on them.
FOCUS-1-waste-rows-on-paper.note: Quantity column visibly unchanged vs master: base page 1/4 read side-by-side — same 10+ figures (84/4/8/25/61/2.5/1015/2485.7/605.9/56/1259.8). Pagination reflows (longer rows push the roof WSP row from base p1 to pin p2) — expected, counts stated in the sheet-N-of-M headers stay right.

FOCUS-2-conventions-block-and-gross-clai.evidence: The B21e convention text lives in the takeoff.ts module header (code comment) — grep of all 47 pin sheet SVGs: zero occurrences of 'convention', zero 'gross', so no printed sheet carries a conventions block and nothing on paper claims a gross buy for member rows. The pilot's statement is verbatim-true: plan-set prints rows as '<section> · <item> — <qty> <unit> (<detail>)' (plan-set.ts:2251+2286). Counter-exhibit proving the fix bites on PAPER: the base subfloor-exhibit sheet prints 'Subfloor 3/4" T&G — 9 sheets (4x8 sheets, gross)' over NET deck arithmetic (the only 'gross' ever printed at master on these four sets), the pin sheet prints '(4x8 sheets from deck members, net — +10% waste ~ 10 sheets)'.
FOCUS-2-conventions-block-and-gross-clai.note: The stated-factor basis ('NAHB-style defaults, verify for your job') is cited in the module header only — a print surface never states it. Acceptable: the row states the factor itself, which is the auditable part; a one-line takeoff footnote is optional polish, queued below.

FOCUS-3-lod200-gross-fallback.evidence: Data surfaces verified: the demo-200 compose books 'Drywall 1/2" — 86 sheets — 4x8 sheets, gross — both faces of interior walls' (the previously-unstated faceArea basis now printed) with NO waste suffix; the synthetic all-fallback compose (gate) shows all three gross rows (WSP/subfloor/drywall) saying 'gross', zero stacked factors; regexp sweep of both rows JSONs — the waste shape appears on exactly the enumerated classes. THE FLAG (pre-existing, byte-identical to master, outside the diff): the printed sheet never shows ANY of this — plan-set.ts:2251 calls computeTakeoff(members, fixtures) WITHOUT areas while panel.tsx:283 passes result.areas, so the LOD-200 paper takeoff omits the drywall/WSP/subfloor gross buys entirely (demo-200 sheet 1/3 walked: lumber + concrete + CMU rows only, no sheet-goods row at all). An examiner comparing the printed set to the panel's number sees the panel 86 sheets richer — the C5 'takeoff complete vs the panel' divergence class.
FOCUS-3-lod200-gross-fallback.note: Board queue, not merge-blocking: thread result.areas into buildPlanSet (opts.areas -> the plan-set computeTakeoff call) so LOD-200 paper books the same buy the panel shows. B21e made the row honest wherever it appears; it did not create the paper omission.

FOCUS-4-roof-deck-caveat-coexistence.evidence: Hip exhibit sheet walked: the deck row prints '1020.6 sqft (deck panels, from members (~32 4x8 sheets, R803.2) — +10% waste ~ 36 sheets; tapered planes conservatively under-tiled (see member labels) — shortfall NOT covered by the stated waste)' — four wrapped lines, both the generic factor and the on-top caveat fully legible, no ellipsis, no overprint. The underlayment row directly below: '1122.7 sqft (one layer felt/synthetic, +10% course laps (R905.1.1) — covering by finish schedule, not booked)' — quantity INCLUDES the lap (1020.6 x 1.1), the word 'waste' never appears on it; the lap-vs-waste opposition is readable on one page. Demo (flat roof, rect panels): deck row carries the +10% waste with NO under-tile caveat — the caveat is tapered-plane-scoped exactly as gated (roof-framing.test.ts B6a update).
FOCUS-4-roof-deck-caveat-coexistence.note: Buy figure honest on the exhibit too: ceil(1020.6 x 1.1 / 32) = 36.

FOCUS-6-regression-byte-story.note: Compose parity: identical member/fixture censuses both sides (2194 @ 400, 1372 @ 200); the diff touches takeoff.ts only.

ADVISORIES.evidence: (a) Ceil-bite cosmetics: every 1-pc and 2-pc stock row prints '+5% waste ~ 2 pcs' / '~ 3 pcs' — a +100%/+50% effective figure under a '+5%' banner (demo: '4x10 — 1 pcs (8 ft stock — +5% waste ~ 2 pcs)'). Deliberate (gated at the 43->46 bite; ordering never rounds down) and defensible — but an estimator may read the label as arithmetic. Wording option: '+5% waste, buy 2 pcs'. (b) Paren nesting: the detail-in-parens print convention yields '(20 ft stock (field splice — run exceeds 20 ft) — +5% waste ~ 9 pcs)' — three-deep parens; pre-existing convention, now longer. (c) The factor-basis citation (NAHB-style, 'verify for your job') never reaches a print surface — a single footnote line under 'Material takeoff' would make the printed estimate self-contained.
ADVISORIES.note: None merge-blocking; (a)/(c) are one-line changes if picked up.
